author: Mod authors: Tangxiaoke, Djr
eyebrow: Don't Starve Together · Mod survival handbook
intro: Items, recipes, enchantments and creatures in MineStarve.
totemHint: Equip in the relic slot to activate
helpBody: Choose Edit with GitHub on a chapter and sign in to edit its document. Contributors create a personal fork if prompted; repository owners edit directly without forking. Save your changes and open a pull request. The page updates after approval.
submitReminder: Saving to your own fork does not submit a review request. Complete Create pull request.
trySearch: Try enchanting, bookshelves, milk or curses.
translationSteps: Choose a language code and chapter. Read the source, then sign in to GitHub to create or edit the translation. Submit a pull request for review. One approved chapter is enough to add a new language to the menu.
createTranslation: Create or edit translation with GitHub ↗
invalidLocale: Enter a valid language code, such as ja, fr or pt-BR.
translationFallback: This chapter is not translated into the selected language yet. Showing English.
translationDraft: Replace this draft with your translated chapter before submitting. Copy the structure from the English source.
